instructions: There are Nine Questions in this paper.
The marks are indicated in the right hand margin.

questions.text: Answer any seven question of the following.

parts.text: Differentiate Information, Knowledge and Meta Knowledge with reference to Artificial Intelligence.
What is Best First Search? Explain in brief that Breadth First Search and Depth First Search are special cases of Best First Search.
Explain Syntactic analysis in short.
Explain non-monotonic reasoning with example.
What is Minimax Procedure?
What are confidence factors?
Difference between Classical and Fuzzy Logic.
How Formal Probability theory differs from Bayesian Probability theory?
Explain Bayesian Networks.

questions.text: What is heuristic search? Explain with example. Also write heuristic function for Hill Climbing and Tic-Tac-Toe.
Distinguish between fuzzy Reasoning and probabilistic reasoning with examples.
Explain Logical Representation Scheme and Procedural Representation Scheme in detail.
Let Ax: "x is an astronaut", Px: "x is a planet", and V(x, y): "x will travel to y". Give Well-Formed Formula for the below.

parts.text: Some astronauts will travel to every planet.
Other astronauts will travel to no planets.
Every planet will be visited by some astronauts.
Every astronaut will travel to at least one planet.
No astronaut will travel only one planet.
Some astronauts will travel many planets.
No planet will be visited by all astronauts.

questions.text: Explain Understanding, Perception, Learning and generation in Natural Language Processing.

parts.text: How are the symbolic structures formed in predicate logic?
Define WFF. Write down the properties of WFF.

questions.text: Explain in detail AO* algorithm and search procedure with a suitable example.

parts.text: Limitations of Expert Systems.
Structured representation of knowledge.
